evaluation.curves: Unity AnimationCurve, non-weighted keys (weightedMode 0): cubic Hermite between key a and b: dt = b.time - a.time; s = (t - a.time)/dt; m0 = a.outSlope*dt; m1 = b.inSlope*dt; v = (2s^3-3s^2+1)a.value + (s^3-2s^2+s)m0 + (-2s^3+3s^2)b.value + (s^3-s^2)m1. If a.outSlope or b.inSlope is +/-Infinity the segment is constant (stepped) at a.value. Weighted keys (weightedMode != 0) use a Bezier with inWeight/outWeight as the tangent lengths (fraction of dt).
evaluation.playback: Vector curves (m_PositionCurves / m_EulerCurves / m_ScaleCurves) are what the runtime plays; m_EditorCurves are the per-component editor copies of the same data (useful to cross-check). m_EulerCurves are interpolated per component in degrees (so 360 -> 1980 spins 4.5 turns) then converted with Quaternion.Euler in m_RotationOrder (4 = ZXY, Unity default: q = qY*qX*qZ). Paths are relative to the GameObject carrying the Animator (the Slot_N root). Properties not animated keep their scene value; clip time beyond the last key clamps (PreInfinity/PostInfinity 2 = Clamp for wrapMode 0 / non-looping).
evaluation.animator: Each Slot_N has an Animator with Slot_N.controller: default state Slot_0N (no transitions). SplineCardDealer.DealCommunity does SetActive(true) on the slot -> the Animator restarts at its default state at t = 0. WithdrawCommunityCards calls animator.Play("Slot_0N_Withdrawal", 0, 0f). Clear() deactivates the slot. Write Defaults is on.
